location_exception_reason: Frisking booths are standardised security infrastructure deployed nationwide at airports, metros, malls, and corporate offices. Location of manufacture or sale does not alter the product's function or buyer decision-making; GI or regional origin does not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in frisking booth titles. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product description complete and accurate.
